system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Namaste, can you help me? Perform action: Sends OTP to the Aadhaar-linked mobile number for Soil Health Card authentication. Here are my details: my mobile_number is 9876565831, my aadhaar_number is 100020002899.

function.name: shc_generate_otp
function.description: Sends OTP to the Aadhaar-linked mobile number for Soil Health Card authentication. Does NOT verify the OTP or create a session. Fails if Aadhaar is invalid or mobile not registered.

function.name: shc_generate_soil_health_card
function.description: Generates the Soil Health Card report for a tested soil sample. Transitions report_status from 'not_generated' to 'generated'. Sample must be in 'tested' status. Requires session_token. Does NOT provide fertilizer recommendations — use shc_get_fertilizer_recommendation. Fails if testing is not complete, sample_id is invalid, or partial nutrient data exists.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

sample_id.description: Unique identifier for a soil sample.
